design: Post-evaluation geometry-input ablation on the same 32 test maps; both models were frozen before primary evaluation. Baseline replays are not additional independent observations.
timing: Raw timings preserved but not compared in this post-evaluation study.

common_success_trajectories.interpretation: Exploratory paired description conditional on both frozen models reaching the goal; not a causal estimate or all-task comparison.
common_success_trajectories.path_length_definition: Sum of 3D chord lengths between stored 0.2 s trajectory samples; identical repeated terminal samples contribute zero.
common_success_trajectories.lateral_excursion_definition: Maximum absolute world-y coordinate; the nominal start-goal line is y=0.
common_success_trajectories.clearance_definition: Minimum uninflated obstacle clearance recorded by the independently integrated plant over the complete successful episode.
